Topic 2.2: Letter sound knowledge

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Letter sound knowledge. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Letter sound knowledge
2. Give Kenyan examples for Letter sound knowledge
3. Practise Letter sound knowledge at school and at home
